## 1.0 Cross Validation

```{r}
library(tidyverse); library(lubridate); library(yardstick); library(here)
source(here("models.R"))

d   <- prep(readRDS(here("data_processed", "analysis.rds")))
dev <- filter(d, year <= 2023)

score_models <- function(train, test) {
  clim <- train |> group_by(wk = week(date)) |> summarise(clim = mean(pm25_next))
  test |>
    mutate(wk = week(date)) |>
    left_join(clim, by = "wk") |>
    transmute(date, region, truth = high_next, pm25_next,
              B1 = pm25, B2 = clim,
              M1 = predict_lasso(fit_lasso(train, FALSE), test),
              M2 = predict_lasso(fit_lasso(train, TRUE),  test),
              M3 = predict_rf(fit_rf(train, FALSE), test),
              M4 = predict_rf(fit_rf(train, TRUE),  test))
}

cv_preds <- map_dfr(2020:2023, \(v)
  score_models(filter(dev, year < v), filter(dev, year == v)) |> mutate(fold = v))
saveRDS(cv_preds, here("data_processed", "cv_preds.rds"))
```

## 1.1 Metrics

```{r}
recall_at <- function(truth, score, rate = 0.05) {
  mean(score[truth == "high"] >= quantile(score, 1 - rate))
}

cv_long <- cv_preds |> pivot_longer(B1:M4, names_to = "model", values_to = "score")

cv_long |>
  group_by(model) |>      # pooled over folds; repeat with group_by(model, fold)
  summarise(roc_auc   = roc_auc_vec(truth, score),
            pr_auc    = pr_auc_vec(truth, score),
            recall_5  = recall_at(truth, score),
            n_high    = sum(truth == "high"))
```

## 1.3 Uncertainty Measurement

```{r}
boot_gain <- function(p, without, with, B = 1000) {
  p <- mutate(p, blk = floor_date(date, "week"))
  blk_info <- p |> group_by(blk) |> summarise(has_high = any(truth == "high"))
  hi <- blk_info$blk[blk_info$has_high]
  lo <- blk_info$blk[!blk_info$has_high]

  gains <- replicate(B, {
    s <- tibble(blk = c(sample(hi, length(hi), replace = TRUE),
                        sample(lo, length(lo), replace = TRUE))) |>
      left_join(p, by = "blk", relationship = "many-to-many")
    pr_auc_vec(s$truth, s[[with]]) - pr_auc_vec(s$truth, s[[without]])
  })

  n_na <- sum(is.na(gains))
  if (n_na > 0) warning(n_na, " of ", B, " draws returned NA")
  c(quantile(gains, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE), n_valid = B - n_na)
}
```

```{r}
count(cv_preds, fold, truth)                 # high days per validation year
colSums(is.na(select(cv_preds, B1:M4)))      # any missing predictions?
```

## 1.4 Final test and Analysis

```{r}
# analysis/40_test.R — run ONCE, after 00_plan.md and tuning settings are committed
library(tidyverse); library(lubridate); library(yardstick); library(here)
set.seed(42)
source(here("models.R"))   # prep(), fit_*(), predict_*(), score_models(), recall_at(), boot_gain()

analysis  <- readRDS(here("data_processed", "analysis.rds"))
T_HIGH    <- readRDS(here("data_processed", "T_HIGH.rds"))
fire_vars <- str_subset(names(analysis), "^(n|frp)_")

d    <- prep(analysis)
dev  <- filter(d, year <= 2023)
test <- filter(d, year == 2024)

# Guard against accidental reruns
out_path <- here("data_processed", "test_preds.rds")
if (file.exists(out_path)) stop("Final test already run: ", out_path,
                                ". Delete it only if you are documenting a rerun.")

# 1. Fit on 2017-2023, predict 2024
test_preds <- score_models(dev, test)
saveRDS(test_preds, out_path)

# 2. Run log for the report
writeLines(c(paste("Final test run:", Sys.time()),
             paste("Git commit:", system("git rev-parse --short HEAD", intern = TRUE)),
             paste("T_HIGH:", T_HIGH),
             paste("Train rows:", nrow(dev), "| Test rows:", nrow(test)),
             paste("High days in 2024:", sum(test_preds$truth == "high"))),
           here("data_processed", "test_run_log.txt"))

# 3. Metrics (same as CV)
n_high <- sum(test_preds$truth == "high")
test_long <- test_preds |> pivot_longer(B1:M4, names_to = "model", values_to = "score")

test_metrics <- test_long |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(
    roc_auc  = if (n_high > 0) roc_auc_vec(truth, score) else NA_real_,
    pr_auc   = if (n_high > 0) pr_auc_vec(truth, score)  else NA_real_,
    recall_5 = if (n_high > 0) recall_at(truth, score)   else NA_real_,
    brier    = if (first(model) %in% c("M1", "M2", "M3", "M4"))
                 brier_class_vec(truth, score) else NA_real_,
    n_high   = n_high,
    .groups  = "drop"
  )
saveRDS(test_metrics, here("data_processed", "test_metrics.rds"))
test_metrics

# 4. Fire-gain intervals (only meaningful with enough high days)
if (n_high >= 10) {
  test_gains <- list(lasso = boot_gain(test_preds, "M1", "M2"),
                     rf    = boot_gain(test_preds, "M3", "M4"))
  saveRDS(test_gains, here("data_processed", "test_gains.rds"))
  test_gains
} else {
  message("Only ", n_high, " high days in 2024: skip the PR-AUC bootstrap, ",
          "report Brier score and the daily-mean regression result instead.")
}

# 5. Per-region breakdown for Step 7d
test_long |>
  group_by(model, region) |>
  summarise(n_high = sum(truth == "high"),
            roc_auc = if (n_high > 0 && n_high < n()) roc_auc_vec(truth, score) else NA_real_,
            .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = roc_auc)
```
